# Iterate through the queue by calling next_song until we hit a liked song
max_steps = len(queue)  # at most the queue length
for step in range(max_steps):
    # Go to next song
    next_resp = apis.spotify.next_song(access_token=access_token)
    # Get the new current song
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    song_id = current['song_id']
    print(f"Step {step+1}: now at song {song_id} - {current['title']}")
    if song_id in liked_ids:
        print(f"Found liked song: {song_id} - {current['title']}")
        break
else:
    print("No liked song found in queue cycle")
